note: Memory bench cases (2026-10-22). Extraction: a produced fact matches an expected one when it contains every term in `must`; messages with an empty `expected` should produce nothing; `days_ago` names the event date the fact should carry, relative to the run day; `context` is the exchange just before the message. Relationships: one existing memory per case; expected type among updates/contradicts/related/none (four types since 2026-10-23). Synthetic, plain personal facts; not anyone's private life. 2026-10-24: e71-e84 added from the kinds of junk seen in real use (translation requests, pasted third-party text, questions restated as facts, TV speech) plus dated facts, feelings, and two cases that need the previous turn to resolve a pronoun.
